newsitem.title: USA: Barrick buys Atlas gold property.
newsitem.headline: Barrick buys Atlas gold property.

text.p: Atlas Corp said on Tuesday that Barrick Gold Corp completed a deal to buy 90 percent of Atlas's Gold Bar properties in Nevada with an option to acquire the balance within two years.
Atlas said Barrick subsidiary Barrick Gold Exploration Inc paid US$1 million in cash on June 6 to Atlas and acquired one million Atlas common shares at US$1 a share.
Atlas shares were trading at 15/32 on the New York Stock Exchange today.
Under the deal, Barrick will spend US$3 million on the property in the next two years.

At Barrick's election, after the two-year term the balance of the Gold Bar property will be conveyed to Barrick, and Atlas may elect to receive an additional US$15 million in cash and retain a two percent net smelter royalty, or participate with Barrick in the exploration and development of Gold Bar as a 25 percent joint venture participant.
Atlas said that if Barrick chose not to acquire the rest of the properties in the two-year period, Barrick's interest in the Gold Bar properties would be reconveyed to Atlas.
